title: Share a course
summary: Give someone your course with an invitation link.
focus: Invitation links, read-only sharing and removing a link
content:
## Make a link

Your courses are private. Sharing needs the *Share courses* permission, which a new account does not have until the person who runs the server gives it. To share one, open it and press **Share**. Give the link a name if you like, so you remember who it is for. Press **Make an invitation link**.

The link shows once. Copy it and send it yourself. Skrongle sends nothing. A course can have up to 50 links.

## Who gets it

The first account that opens the link keeps the course. Anyone else who opens the same link is turned away. Make one link for each person.

Someone without an account is sent to the login page first. After they sign in or register, the link continues.

## What they can do

They learn from your course with their own progress. They cannot change it. Your later edits reach them at once, because it is the same course.

## Take it back

The Share dialog lists each link as *not opened yet* or *opened by* a name. **Remove** takes the link away. The course leaves that person's list too.

To get a private copy of a course to change, use the copy icon in the course's settings.

a web address that gives one account your course
you can learn from it but not change it

quiz.prompt: How many invitation links can one course have, at most?
quiz.explanation: A course can have up to 50 links.
hints: It is a round number above forty.

quiz.prompt: Two people open the same invitation link. Who keeps the course?
quiz.explanation: The first account to open the link keeps the course. Others are turned away.
hints: A link is for one person.

quiz.prompt: Skrongle sends the invitation link to the person for you.
quiz.explanation: You copy the link and pass it on yourself. Nothing is sent from the app.
hints: You decide how to send it.

quiz.prompt: A person you shared a course with can edit its lessons.
quiz.explanation: A shared course is read only for them. Only you can change it.

quiz.prompt: What does Remove do on a link?
options: Takes the course off that person's list
quiz.correct_answer: Takes the course off that person's list
quiz.explanation: Removing a link takes the link away, and the course leaves the list of the person who opened it.

sorts.title: Who can do it?
buckets: Owner and people with a link

items.text: Use Sprint mode and Study mode on the course

sorts.why: The owner controls the course and the links. Everyone learns from it.
